# Feats #351 source and behavior fixtures

Exactly 100 ordered pf1-content 11.4.0 feat candidates from #351. Source YAML, manifests and comparison files retain their exact pinned bytes. Supporting bodies are audit evidence; they do not expand the selected import or silently install linked spell definitions.

The legal inventory is `scripts/catalog/legal/feats-351.json`. It contains the complete root/manual mechanics review, separate evidence roles, notice minima, named holds and current assessment bindings. `preview.json` retains complete-source prerequisite facts explicitly while portable fixture imports contain only the selected definitions. `data.ts` reads large data through typed validation rather than a direct import.

`original-identities.json` freezes every prior fixture/inventory blob and each raw shared value before additions. `protected-context.json` independently recomputes the complete historical context union, including held dependencies. Frightening Ambush and Kraken Style preserve their prior output with explicit empty optional records; their complete text and independent missing calculations remain in the inventory.

The public resolver tests exercise real published numeric values and exact conditional scopes. The isolated Convex tests save each of the three admitted Skill Focus specializations, compare +3/+6 copies without stacking, another skill, deactivation, foreign Character/definition boundaries, release transport and public legal readback. Tests create only isolated fixture data and do not access a deployment or publish a production release.

`release.json` is a three-definition isolated release; `verification.json` records the standalone complete proof. Empty pack directories have `.gitkeep` files for portable reconstruction. Temporary storage follows the caller's external TMPDIR.


The review fix records exact source type, subtype, owner, pinned version, raw description presence and body role for every supporting record. Correct feat/class/race bodies replace same-name grant/buff/subtype proxies. Retained rejected leads and partial summaries are used only by the collision/body-sufficiency regressions; they do not govern the root or add Notes. Worg's absent description remains missing-body evidence. The unused rejected Druid-domain Familiar fixture was removed; its history remains in external archived evidence. Generic animal companion and selected-power gaps remain explicit.
